paragraphs.text: Narci is a legendary bard on Theros .

Narci is a teller of tales, singer of fables, and recounter of sagas . She is young, with dark brown skin and long black hair tied in numerous braids and adorned with golden beads. She wears a green dress and various golden jewelry and has a golden mask at her hip. Draped around her are several black veils, and in her hands she strums a magical glowing lyre. She can be seen in a field of shimmering green flowers, sparkling along with the stars above her.
